subject: Implement the five-protocol council design with a router and circuit breakers
directive: Owner directive 2026-10-07: design and implement the council as FIVE selectable operating protocols with tunable participation variables, a protocol router, and circuit breakers. Update .project/dev-loop/DESIGN-COUNCIL.md (and, if you own a council runtime/automation, its prompt) to define, ready to run: (1) VARIABLES: #models (how many distinct models answer), #providers (how many independent providers - diversity is measured in providers, not models; several models behind one provider share a failure mode), #concurrent (same-prompt parallel width), #challenge-prompt (the adversarial second pass), #rounds (round-robin depth, 1 rebuttal default). (2) FIVE PROTOCOLS: PANEL (one question, N independent answers, no cross-talk -> position spread); CHALLENGE (each answer attacks the others' weakest claim -> what consensus missed); ROUND-ROBIN (sequential, each sees priors, one position each -> convergence); VOTE (every model votes yes/no/abstain on the ruling; needs a supermajority -> opinion becomes a decision); JUDGE (one model NOT in the panel reads everything and rules, recording contradictions verbatim -> the ruling). (3) PROTOCOL ROUTER: pick protocol(s) by stakes - routine -> PANEL alone; contested -> PANEL+CHALLENGE; real dispute -> ROUND-ROBIN+JUDGE; anything touching owner-reserved ground (auth, provider/model config, spend, mission, invariants) -> ABSTAIN and queue for Owen. (4) FIVE CIRCUIT BREAKERS that abort a ruling instead of burning through it: QUORUM-LOSS (fewer than two live independent families -> no ruling, block); CONVERGENCE (unanimous panel on a high-stakes question -> escalate, never rubber-stamp); LOOP-BREAKER (three rounds with no position change -> stop, stuck not converging); DRIFT (a voice answers outside the brief's constraints -> drop it); COST/TIME (hard ceiling on calls per ruling). (5) A KNOWN-LIVE RESERVE for re-pinning: the GPT/Codex family (9/9 live 2026-10-07) and space-bunny-free (verified live 2026-10-07 by the CoS dispatch); keep the dark list current from PROVIDER-AVAILABILITY.md. Wire the DEVOPS-TEAM.md cross-reference: a provider going dark changes which protocols are available - record it as a routing input. Keep the existing invariants: rulings are recommendations never authority, contradictions recorded not smoothed, one rebuttal default, refuse-to-decide is valid. Propose the default settings (e.g. #models 3, #providers 3, #concurrent 3, #rounds 2, vote supermajority 2/3) for Owen to confirm. Reply DONE with the commit hash and the defaults you proposed.
